title: Feeling jittery today?
caption: Feeling jittery today? Space is a bit stormy, so you may feel wired and tired at once, with focus in short bursts and head or mood a little louder. When the buzz spikes, try 5–10 minutes of slow breathing or a brief walk, and keep tasks in small chunks with short pauses.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity pushed into storm territory and may pulse again as the field dips south at times. Solar wind is moderate rather than extreme. A couple of small solar flares and one CME were noted recently, with no clear aim at Earth. Local weather and pressure still shape how this lands for you.
affects: Some may feel wired and tired at once, with shorter steady‑focus windows. Head and mood can run louder in this pattern, especially for sensitive folks. Sleep may feel lighter unless you protect the evening wind‑down. Quiet local skies don’t erase carryover from the past few active days.
playbook:
- Use 5–10 min of slow breathing or a brief walk when the buzz spikes
- Keep tasks in small chunks with short pauses
- Hydrate and catch a bit of daylight movement
- Dim screens earlier and keep bedtime simple
- If storms, pressure swings, or smoke are local, plan lighter
